press_references.value: Humain & Nvidia Partner on Saudi AI Infrastructure

partnership_announcements.description: Humain, the AI subsidiary of Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund, and Nvidia have entered a multi-year partnership to build large-scale AI infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, including AI factories up to 500 MW, hundreds of thousands of GPUs, an 18,000‑GPU GB300 Grace Blackwell supercomputer, and deployment of Nvidia Omniverse for mobility, robotics, manufacturing and logistics applications.

press_references.value: HUMAIN and Blackstone-backed AirTrunk announce partnership

partnership_announcements.description: HUMAIN and AirTrunk, with Blackstone as a partner, announced a strategic partnership to finance, develop, and operate AI‑ready hyperscale data centers in Saudi Arabia, starting with an approximately $3 billion campus and marking AirTrunk’s entry into the Middle East.

about_short_description.short_description: HUMAIN is a global artificial intelligence company delivering full-stack AI capabilities

product.name: HUMAIN IQ
product.description: An end-to-end AI platform and service offering covering ethical data acquisition, model training, deployment, data solutions, AI models, and production-ready enterprise AI applications.

identifier.value: AI Infrastructure, Cloud Services, and Data Centers

product.name: AI Infrastructure, Cloud Services, and Data Centers
product.description: AI compute and cloud infrastructure for model training, inference, data storage, high-speed data movement, and elastic workloads, supported by sovereign AI-native data centers.

product.name: HUMAIN Data Platform
product.description: A governed data platform for ingesting, orchestrating, processing, visualizing, and securely managing data, with APIs, integration adapters, and AI/ML services.

product.name: ALLAM 34B
product.description: A Saudi-developed Arabic and English large language model trained on extensive Arabic-language data and designed for culturally and linguistically aware AI applications.

product.name: HUMAIN Chat
product.description: An Arabic-focused conversational AI application powered by the ALLAM 34B model, available through web and mobile experiences with real-time access to online information.

product.name: HUMAIN OS
product.description: An enterprise AI operating system that connects business data, models, and workflows to provide natural-language search, analytics, task automation, scheduling, and role-specific assistance.
